live_development_smoke: Requires a separate exact prepared-run authorization, committed inputs, current Ollama digest/version and a fresh 30-second resource gate; only that run's model is unloaded afterwards.
network: fixed run-bound loopback gateway; Mirror additionally needs one fixed loopback AgentRPC port
tool_policy: Native upstream tools under OS containment; fixture reads, existing artifact-contract targets writable, pinned runtimes executable. Shell commands are not restricted to the exact public-test command. This differs from Pi and Mini and must remain a separate complete-system condition. A declared scratch directory under isolated agent-state is writable; no additional fixture paths become writable. Scratch checks use explicit files and absolute runtime commands. macOS Bash here-docs remain unsupported under this containment policy; the prompt declares this limitation.
hidden_verification: Separate finalization after all harness processes exit and workspace/wire artifacts freeze.
inference_settings: Explicit native Ollama text/tool bridge. Record original CLI request, effective /api/chat body, raw native NDJSON and client response. think=false, temperature=0, seed=42, num_ctx=16384, num_predict<=1600 on every request including compaction; a smaller native CLI output ceiling is honored. Observe runtime context separately. Unexpected thinking or incomplete native termination fails qualification.
non_coding_admission: Log and document cases require separately qualified tool/output contracts; not admitted by this coding integration.

mirror.mode: native Rust agent via Python exec client; transparent AgentRPC capture and fixed RPC port
mirror.ripgrep: MIRROR_RG_PATH selects one existing exact executable; its path and SHA-256 are bound per preparation, rather than executing an unpinned temporary extraction.

vibe.mode: Python CLI with explicit --legacy-harness; streaming JSON plus native export

condition_changes: Explicit opt-in native Ollama provider bridge with the complete fixed generation profile, also applied to compaction.
Mirror native output ceiling becomes 1600 to match the Mini/Pi reference per-turn ceiling; the bridge honors smaller native ceilings.
Declare isolated scratch directory, supported file-based scratch commands, unsupported Bash here-docs and explicit final-summary instruction; fixture/artifact integrity boundary is unchanged.
comparison_limit: Provider/tool qualification only. This explicit bridge is a distinct complete-system condition. Older Mini/Pi labels do not prove matched effective backend controls; Pi needs its own separately versioned bridge/sandbox qualification before a matched four-system experiment. No measured sweep or causal timing conclusion is admitted.
